name: Ending in E

parts.title: Call
parts.text: Open B, a quick step up to the high E, then the full bend on the 3rd fret and its release.

parts.title: Turn
parts.text: Chromatic 2-3-2-0 on the B string. Same finger on the 2nd fret both times.

parts.title: Landing
parts.text: Down through G and D, the G-G# climb, a full bend on the low E, and the E chord.

practice: Watch the slow take a couple of times before you play.
Learn it in three chunks, one at a time.

practice.no_app: Start slow; speed up only when a chunk is clean.
practice.app: Loop each chunk in {app_name} at x0.5, then x0.75, then x1.

practice: Bend until the 3rd fret sounds like the 5th. No half-way.
Join the chunks and play along with the fast take.
Make it yours: end on E7 (0-3-0-1-2-0) or move the turn up an octave.

post.title: Blues Licks Series — Ending in E
body: A short blues ending in E that sits in open position: a full bend on the high E, a chromatic turn on the B string, and a walk down to the E chord with one more bend on the low E.
The video plays it twice: full speed first, then slow. The tab runs with the playing, and in the slow take the open top strings light up on the guitar, so you see exactly when they ring.

body.no_app:
How to learn it:
1. Watch the slow take a couple of times before you play.
2. Learn it in three chunks: notes 1–7, 8–11, 12–19.
3. Start slow and speed up only when each chunk is clean.
4. Bend until the 3rd fret sounds like the 5th. No half-way.
5. Join the chunks and play along with the fast take.
6. Make it yours: end on E7 or move the B-string turn up an octave.
